Repeated prisoner's dilemma — supergame {{ supergame_index }}, round {{ round_in_match }}. Condition: {{ condition }}.

Payoffs each round (yours, partner's): (C,C)→(48,48); (D,D)→(25,25); (D,C)→(50,12); (C,D)→(12,50). After each round there is a 90% chance the supergame continues, 10% it ends.

Information feedback by condition:
  perfect_monitoring → you see your partner's exact last action.
  public → both you and your partner see the same pair of noisy signals (each correct with prob 0.9) about both actions.
  private → you see only a noisy signal about your partner's last action; they see only one about yours.
